description: This Java class 'GLIMAccountInfoWritePlatformServiceImpl' implements the 'GLIMAccountInfoWritePlatformService' interface. It provides methods to create and update GLIM (Group Lending and Individual Monitoring) account information within a loan portfolio management system, including creating accounts, setting acceptance flags, and incrementing child account counts. The class interacts with a repository for persistence.

classes.name: GLIMAccountInfoWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: This class implements the service for managing GLIM account information, including creating accounts and updating their properties.

methods.name: createGLIMAccount
methods.description: Creates a new GLIM account with provided details and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: setIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Sets the GLIM account's 'isAcceptingChild' status to true and saves the update.

methods.name: resetIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Sets the 'isAcceptingChild' status to false and saves the update.

methods.name: incrementChildAccountCount
methods.description: Increments the child account count for the given GLIM account and saves the update.
